outlook: Overnight trade was quiet ahead of USDA's October WASDE and Crop Production reports at 11 am CT today. November soybeans were up about 5 cents near $12.92½, helped by hopes China resumes buying new-crop U.S. beans after its Golden Week holiday, while December corn was unchanged at $5.00¼ and December Chicago wheat slipped less than a penny. Analysts expect USDA to trim the corn yield to about 177.8 bu/acre and put soybean yield near 52.8, with corn ending stocks around 1.68 billion bushels and soybeans around 305 million. Minneapolis December spring wheat saw little overnight trade near Thursday's $7.06 settlement, ICE canola last settled at C$820.30, and clear weather is pushing harvest along quickly.
